data.name: Telegram MxGram
data.subtitle: Official Telegram with the MxGram tweak
data.localizedDescription: MxGram injects the MxGram tweak into the official Telegram app: ghost mode with per-user exceptions, anti-revoke and anti-edit, saving of protected media, fake GPS, download boost and more, localized in 10 languages.

compatibility.notes: Official project: m1ronx1412/mxgram (publishes the tweak as .deb/.dylib only); this source serves the ready-to-sideload IPA build from the IPA Vault. Telegram 12.x requires iOS 13 or newer. Shares ph.telegra.Telegraph with a sideloaded stock Telegram - install one at a time.
